title: Range queries
hints: `lowerBound` with binary lifting: start at position 0 with the largest power of two `step <= n`. If `t[pos + step] < target`, the answer is past that block: move `pos` forward and subtract the block's sum from the target. Halve `step` and repeat. The answer is `pos + 1`.

A compact segment tree keeps the leaves in `t[n .. 2n)` and node `i`'s children at `2i` and `2i + 1`. A query walks two indexes up from both ends of the range, taking a node whenever the index is on the "outside" of its parent.
